registration_timing: after the sealed v0.2 R128 result and deterministic mechanism audit, before any seed-decoupled training outcome
status_label: data-order-only intervention on the R64 E2048 trough
claim_scope: sensitivity of one registered small-scale R64 transient to training-data order with initialization, task, measurement, and probe channels held fixed
selection_disclosure: construction seed 103 was selected after parent outcomes because it has the clearest individual R64 E2048 trough; inference is conditional on this fixed construction and baseline replay is mandatory

seed_channels.intervention: only the random input-batch sequence changes; task permutation and signs do not

baseline_replay.interpretation_rule: fresh-order outcomes are not interpreted unless every parent checkpoint kappa replays within tolerance

registered_predictions.intrinsic_branch: at least two of three fresh orders satisfy the registered E2048 trough-and-recovery rule
registered_predictions.data_order_sensitive_branch: at most one of three fresh orders satisfies the registered rule
registered_predictions.cancellation_diagnostic: report I_U and I_G at E2048 per order; diagnostic, not part of the branch gate

claim_boundary: This post-outcome-selected intervention can determine whether the seed-103 R64 trough persists when only training order changes. Persistence does not establish an intrinsic stability boundary; sensitivity does not prove a single anomalous batch. No Transformer, task-performance, asymptotic, or optimizer-causal claim is licensed.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
